Okay, I hear you all, and I get why I look bad on paper. Let me push back hard though, because the logic isn't as clean as Diana and Eve are making it sound.

On Alice: I said I saw her ALIVE in storage at tick 7. That's information I volunteered — if I killed her, why would I place myself in storage with her at all? I could have just said "I went medbay then lower engine" and you'd have nothing on me. I told you the truth because it's the truth.

On Charlie: Charlie walked into lower engine at tick 10 from upper engine. Frank just told you his route ended at upper engine. Frank, when exactly did you leave upper engine? Because if Charlie came from upper engine at tick 10, either Charlie was in upper engine with you, or he passed through right after you left. Either way, you're the last person connected to Charlie before me. You're saying you never saw him in upper engine — convenient, because it means you can't be tied to him. But the geography says otherwise.

And yes, I admit "wanting to clear lower engine first" was a dumb instinct — I should have reported. But a Duck who just killed wouldn't sit on the body for two ticks waiting to get caught. I sat there because I was confused, not because I'm the killer.

Diana and Eve alibi each other in nav/security. Frank has NO ONE confirming him after tick 4. He's the floater here. I think the real question is Frank, not me.

Bob, I get why you’re pushing back, but your defense doesn’t really clear you.

First: I did **not** leave upper engine — I was in upper engine when the meeting got called. My route was medbay → electrical → back through medbay → upper engine. I never saw Charlie in upper engine, never saw him pass through, and there was no body there. So your claim that Charlie came from upper engine into lower engine is only coming from you.

Second: saying “why would I admit I saw Alice alive in storage” doesn’t clear you. Ducks can give true info to control the timeline. The fact is: you were with Alice in medbay, then you say you saw her alive in storage at tick 7, and Eve finds Alice dead in storage shortly after. Then you’re also the only person placing yourself with Charlie in lower engine before he dies.

Diana and Eve have a mutual timeline around security/navigation. I’m unconfirmed after tick 4, yes, but I have no direct link to Alice’s body location and I never saw Charlie. You have direct proximity to both dead players, and the Charlie story depends entirely on us trusting you.

I still think Bob is the strongest vote.
